There are a lot of tools to track statistics for account (such as our wblitz.net website), but BlitzSession application offers you to track statistics for a certain period of time - the game session. Just add your account, tap "Start new session" and play the game. When you are ready, tap "Get results" and you'll see the main indicators: amount of battles, winrate, average damage, average tier, SR (session rating), and statistics for each vehicle that you played. If you want to start over, tap "End session". This would save your results to archive.

Another feature - you can track an unlimited accounts on each game server. Therefore, if you have several accounts and play on the EU, NA, RU or ASIA servers, you can track them all. Or, if you are a clan leader, you can track the sessions of your clan-mates. Or you can track the sessions of famous and popular players, streamers or anyone you interested in.

Hope you enjoy our app! Have an excited battles and don't forget to share your session results!

Watch Tuner Timegrapher is a mechanical (automatic or manual winding) watch testing application. It displays a frequency diagram of the watch and measures rate, beat error, amplitude and beats per hour.

 The application uses the build-in or headset's microphone to record audible ticks of the watch.  

Use this application in a quiet environment. Any ambient noise can affect result accuracy. Complete silence is the best however noise cancelling algorithm can help to eliminate not very loud sounds.The recommended way to record the ticks is to touch the crown of the watch with the headset (earplugs) microphone.

If you don't need the frequency diagram, look at Watch Tuner app.
If you want to test only the rate accuracy, try Watch Tuner Lite.

If you have any questions, suggestions or any troubles using this app - don't hesitate to write me.

There are 2 ways to add watermarks in the app:
*Custom watermark
* Template watermark

CUSTOM WATERMARK
Use the built-in editor, add any number of watermarks and place them on a pdf or photo the way you want. You can add text, photo or qr codes.

TEMPLATE WATERMARK
Use quick templates to add text or image to pdf or photo. When working with PDF, you can also specify which pages should be watermarked, or vice versa - specify which pages should be left blank.

------------
* Ability to render pdf pages as images. It is almost impossible to remove a watermark from such documents using standard tools. Also, text selection and search will not work;

* Work with multiple documents or photos in a template watermark;

* You do not need to create logos in advance. It is enough to select a file and place text or a logo on it using one of the available methods;

* Preview. When adding a watermark using templates, you can immediately see the result based on the first page of the document (or photo), so you can adjust the settings and save the final result.
